title: Instrumentation observes each layer without creating authority
summary: Messaging/Presence, XMPP, BOSH, HTTP and lower transport may publish their own operational facts. Instrumentation Mesh correlation is explicit evidence grouping, never inferred causality or control authority.
invariants: Semantic sends/presence operations and lower carrier exchanges are counted by the layer that owns those facts; retries do not fabricate extra semantic sends.
Instrumentation excludes message/stanza payload, credentials and endpoint/user identity unless an explicit privacy contract says otherwise.
BOSH does not infer correlation from the same endpoint, session, connection, timestamp, target, payload or XTP path.
Correlation, causation and context references are carried only when explicitly supplied by an authority entitled to assert them.
Instrumentation exposes no Messaging, Presence, XMPP, BOSH, HTTP or transport management authority.

provenance.claim: Projects semantic service facts onto Instrumentation Mesh without changing service authority.
Projects BOSH operational facts with explicit-only correlation semantics.
